newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's EBS cuts fixed rates for new borrowers.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's EBS cuts fixed rates for new borrowers.

text.p: Ireland's EBS Building Society said on Tuesday that it was cutting its fixed mortgage rates for new borrowers with immediate effect.

"Medium and longer term interest rates have eased reflecting the confidence of international investors in the strong performance of the Irish economy, particularly in the run-up to EMU," EBS said in a statement.
The new one-year fixed rate for new borrowers is 5.85 percent while EBS is offering a three-year fixed rate of 7.05 percent and a five-year fixed rate of 7.5 percent.
